protocol: Primary first-use model comparison cohort frozen from raw RGB before viewing/evaluating either counter. Single reviewer, no independent human adjudication. Windows in clip-relative seconds denote approximate lowest handle position and subsequent completion of an overhead return, sampled at 4 Hz. Require a prior overhead endpoint and exclude partial cycles, even if they visibly pass bottom. First three cycles always reserved for calibration, matching baseline evaluator. Each underlying film represents a different session/athlete here. Searched for SHA, item ID, title and matching scenes in prior project manifests. Cropped or fast sets and multi-person backgrounds remain in the cohort even if tracking fails. No looping, artificial repetitions or model-based filtering.
